name: Lacerta Film Lab
creator: Lacerta Film Lab
description: Resolve OpenFX film-emulation plugin with modeled negatives, printer lights, print response, halation, grain and LUT export. Windows/Linux 64-bit and macOS Intel/Apple Silicon builds. $249 perpetual license for one machine with online activation; unlimited demo has a watermark and disables LUT export. Exact Resolve edition/version is not established.
